title: AVIO: Learning to Add and Remove Sounding Objects in Audiovisual Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2609.36503v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adding or removing a sounding object requires coordinated changes to visual content and sound while preserving the surrounding scene. Yet paired supervision for localized non-speech audiovisual editing remains limited, as visual and acoustic edits must target the same object and isolate its sound from overlapping sources. To address this gap, we introduce \textit{AVIOBench}, a dataset comprising 37.9 hours of paired audiovisual examples spanning 1{,}878 target-object names. AVIOBench links the visual presence and acoustic contribution of each target object through a shared identity and visual mask. Our automated pipeline uses visual grounding and cross-modal consistency to select target-sound removal candidates, then jointly refines the audiovisual pairs to improve perceptual quality and cross-modal consistency. translated_title: AVIO：学习在视听场景中添加与移除发声物体
translated_abstract: 在场景中添加或移除一个发声物体，需要对视觉内容和声音进行协调一致的修改，同时保留周围场景。然而，针对局部化非语音视听编辑的成对监督数据仍然有限，因为视觉与听觉的编辑必须针对同一物体，并将其声音从相互重叠的声源中分离出来。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了 AVIOBench，这是一个包含 37.9 小时成对视听示例的数据集，涵盖 1,878 个目标物体名称。AVIOBench 通过共享的身份标识与视觉掩码，将每个目标物体的视觉存在与其声学贡献关联起来。我们的自动化流程利用视觉定位（visual grounding）和跨模态一致性来筛选目标声音移除的候选样本，随后对视听样本对进行联合精修，以提升感知质量与跨模态一致性。基于该数据集，我们提出了 AVIO，它通过对预训练的文本到视听生成模型进行适配（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文构建了首个针对“添加/移除发声物体”这一任务的成对视听数据集 AVIOBench（37.9 小时、1,878 个目标物体类别），并基于预训练文本到视听生成模型提出 AVIO 方法，实现画面与声音协调一致的局部化视听编辑。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AVIOBench, the first paired audiovisual dataset (37.9 hours, 1,878 target object classes) for adding/removing sounding objects, and proposes AVIO, which adapts a pretrained text-to-audiovisual generation model to perform coherent, localized audiovisual editing.
